{{Quote|More than five millennia ago the Denarii Nova exploded, ripping through these stars and reducing them to cinders. The powerful Sith sorcerer Naga Sadow caused this cataclysmic event to gain his freedom from pursuing Republic warships. With the extravagant power of the dark side, Naga Sadow tore these two stars apart and used giant flares like two slapping hands to crush the fleet behind him.|[[Brakiss]], to [[Zekk]]|<ref name="Lightsabers">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]''</ref>}}
The '''battle at the Denarii Nova''' was fought in the [[Denarii system]] at the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Those flares&hellip; the explosions&hellip; Naga Sadow must have been destroyed.''"<br />"''Recall what's left of our fleet. Let's go home. We've lost enough ships today in this cursed empire.|[[Jori Daragon]] and [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]]|<ref name="TFotSE5" />}}
[[File:Denarii_supernova.png|thumb|left|220px|The explosion created by Naga Sadow]]
Following his [[Second battle of Korriban|defeat]] at [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] set course for<ref name="TFotSE5" /> the [[Denarii system]]<ref name="TEA" /> aboard his [[Derriphan-class battleship|''Derriphan''-class battleship]],<ref name="KotORCG" /> the [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']].<ref name="CSWE" /> Pursued by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Koros fleet|forces]], Sadow maneuvered his damaged [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] between the [[Binary star system/Legends|binary stars]] of the [[Denarii Nova]]. The [[Sith sorcerer]] then used his [[Sith sorcery/Legends|powers]] to [[Supernova (Sith magic)|manipulate]] the [[Solar flare/Legends|solar flares]] of the Denarii Nova. The resulting explosion destroyed the Republic [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in his wake and allowed him to stage his own [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="TFotSE5" />

This cataclysmic event also resulted in the destruction of the entire [[Star system/Legends|system]],<ref name="DLotS1" /> which created a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] of highly ionized [[Gas/Legends|gases]] known as the [[Denarii Nebula/Legends|Denarii Nebula]].<ref name="TEA" />

In the aftermath of the battle, Sadow, his [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] followers, and his [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] crew settled on the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="TFotSE5" />
